svg.text: Make two. Wool felt 10 mm thick, cut 1,000 x 260 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cover: heavy canvas sewn as a flat tube around the felt,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with a 300 mm wide pocket open at both ends so the band

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It is padding only. It must not stiffen the band: no boards,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rods or plates of any kind inside it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It sits under the animal's chest or flank, centred on the band.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the band slides through by hand; the sleeve folds flat.
